# deepseek-cli

> The whole DeepSeek API from the command line. One Go binary speaking all
> four of DeepSeek's wire formats (OpenAI chat, OpenAI Responses, Anthropic
> Messages, FIM), plus models and balance. Keeps multi-turn conversations
> correct across DeepSeek's reasoning_content replay rule, and prices every
> call from the published rate card into a local ledger.

Install: `go install github.com/thevibeworks/deepseek-cli/cmd/deepseek@latest`
Auth: `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, or `~/.config/deepseek/api_key`.
Contract: stdout is data, stderr is status. `--json` prints the API's own
response body unmodified. Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 auth, 3 no balance,
4 rate limited, 130 interrupted.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): what it is, install, every command with examples, cost model, configuration, and the API behaviours that surprise people
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the scripting contract — commands, flags, JSON response shapes per format, exit-code semantics, and cautions. Start here when driving the tool from code
- [skill/SKILL.md](skill/SKILL.md): drop-in agent skill; the same contract as an operational procedure
- [TASTE.md](TASTE.md): design rejections and their reasons — why one command per format rather than one `--api` flag, why `--json` is never wrapped, why announced-but-undated pricing is not applied, why tool calls are printed and not executed
- [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md): what touches your key, prompts and disk; reporting

## Source

- [internal/deepseek](internal/deepseek): the API client. `client.go` transport, auth, retry policy; `chat.go` `responses.go` `anthropic.go` `fim.go` `meta.go` one file per endpoint; `sse.go` streaming for both SSE dialects; `pricing.go` the rate card and cost/cache-savings arithmetic; `errors.go` error envelope and exit-code classification
- [internal/cli](internal/cli): command tree. One file per command, plus `output.go` (the stdout/stderr contract) and `input.go` (prompt assembly from args, files and stdin)
- [internal/session](internal/session): stored conversations and the reasoning_content replay rule
- [internal/ledger](internal/ledger): append-only usage log and its reports

## Reference

- [DeepSeek API docs](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/): the upstream API this wraps
- [Models & pricing](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing): the rate card `pricing.go` encodes
